original_pr.refresh_action: Merged current origin/dev, applied recovery projection deadlock elimination (sync_projection=False under launch lock, deferred sync outside runtime_state_lock in promotion_launch_guard), sanitized child env in test_supervisor_recovery_process_e2e, verified full test suites, and pushed to origin.

original_deadlocked_run.failure_mode: Smoke acceptance hung at 6-hour timeout due to inter-process lock contention on runtime_state_lock between supervisor parent and ai_status.py recover child.

root_cause.summary: In PR #5736, promotion_launch_guard holds runtime_state_lock(config) across start_worker_for_request. When recovering a worker, mark_worker_recovery_materialized synchronously invoked sync_status_pipeline(config), spawning ai_status.py recover. The child process attempted to acquire runtime_state_lock(config, shared=True), causing an inter-process lock deadlock between parent and child that hung CI until cancelled at the 6-hour timeout.
stack: subprocess.run (ai_status.py recover -> runtime_state_lock contends with parent)

resolution.summary: Decouple synchronous status pipeline sync from the locked worker launch phase and mark_worker_recovery_materialized; execute sync_status_pipeline strictly outside runtime_state_lock; preserve admission fencing and unify supervisor imports across both branches.

changes.detail: Add sync_projection: bool = True parameter to mark_worker_recovery_materialized; pass sync_projection=False in start_worker_for_request. In promotion_launch_guard, execute sync_status_pipeline(config) strictly outside the runtime_state_lock block. Reconcile imports to unify ordering.

Add test_mark_worker_recovery_materialized_sync_projection_flag and test_promotion_launch_guard_defers_recovery_projection_outside_runtime_lock to verify the sync_projection flag and lock release timing.

Sanitize runner coordination variables (ORCH_RUNNER_STATUS_PATH, ORCH_HEARTBEAT_PATH, etc.) in test environments so child CLI processes validate PANTHEON_STATUS_ROOT cleanly when executed under worker runtimes.
